text: grep -n 'fn emit_mkdir_libc_helper' -A 30 src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fs.rs | head -35: "jz __rt_mkdir_walk_next"); // a leading '/' names the root, which always exists 569- emitter.instruction("mov BYTE PTR [r11 + r10], 0"); // terminate here so the buffer names the parent 570- emitter.instruction("mov rdi, r11"); // pass the parent path to libc mkdir() 571- emitter.instruction("mov rsi, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]"); // parents are created with the requested mode 572- emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 32], r10"); // preserve the scan index across the libc call 573- emitter.instruction("call mkdir"); // create the parent, ignoring EEXIST and every other failure 574- emitter.instruction("mov r10, QWORD PTR [rbp - 32]"); // restore the scan index 575- emitter.instruction("mov r11, QWORD PTR [rbp - 24]"); // restore the buffer base 576- emitter.instruction("mov BYTE PTR [r11 + r10], 47"); // put the separator back before scanning on 577- emitter.label("__rt_mkdir_walk_next");
